verdict.rationale: Clerky documents that it logs every change anyone makes to a document set or workspace, which gives an attributable activity trail, and its documents are signed on Clerky. Nothing in the evidence shows the log is tamper-evident (e.g., hashing or sealing) or that a completion certificate is issued per signed document. Missing for 10: tamper-evidence of the audit trail, per-document signing completion certificates, signature-event detail (timestamps, IP, identity verification), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can rely on a tamper-evident audit trail and completion certificate for every signed document

citations.quote: We log every change anyone makes to a document set or workspace, so you can always see who was responsible for what.
Users enter formation information in your product and sign documents on Clerky.
